name: The Shallow Benthos
flavor: Sunlit sea floor. Microbial mats, slow grazers, and the first things that learned to bite back.

name: The Open Water
flavor: The column above the floor — fast, exposed, nowhere to hide. Sustained gill capacity is not optional.

name: The Reef Edge
flavor: Structure and shelter; ambush country. You do not walk in without crypsis.
